org_dashboard.title: Organization Dashboard
org_dashboard.overview_intro: This is your organisation's dashboard. Approve people who apply to volunteer, and approve the hours they log — approving hours credits the volunteer automatically, 1 time credit per hour.
org_dashboard.autocredit_desc: When you approve someone's logged hours, the time credits go to their wallet straight away — 1 credit per hour. You don't need to fund anything first.
org_dashboard.autopay_on_desc: Volunteers are automatically paid time credits when their hours are approved.
org_dashboard.autopay_off_desc: Hours are approved but volunteers are not automatically paid. Enable auto-pay in the Wallet tab.
org_dashboard.access_denied_desc: You do not have permission to manage this organization, or it does not exist.
org_dashboard.load_error_desc: Something went wrong while loading your organisation. Please check your connection and try again.

heading: Volunteering
subtitle: Find opportunities and track your impact
page_description: Discover volunteering opportunities in your community. Sign up, track your hours, and make an impact.
volunteer_view_subtitle: Find opportunities, sign up, and log the hours you give.
how_it_works: Find an opportunity and apply. Once you're accepted, log the hours you give. When the organisation approves your hours, you receive 1 time credit for every hour — added straight to your wallet.
